description: Which mobs dig through blocks toward their target, and which blocks they can dig, for mobDigging and canMobDig. Hand-written from the bytecode of Epic Siege Mod 13.169 (pinned pack zip), ESM-Tweaks 0.4.5 (downloaded at server start, see sources) and Tool Progression 1.6.12 (pinned pack zip), read with javap only, and from the pack's configs; excerpts and config copies in packages/rotn-data/test/fixtures/mob-digging-3.3.4/. confidence 'verified' = read from that bytecode and config; nothing here was watched in a run.
summary: Mobs listed in diggers dig toward their attack target when they have no path to it and stand still. Those with requiresTools true dig only blocks that need no tool (dirt, grass, sand, gravel, clay, wood, logs, planks, glass, leaves, wool: material that needs no tool, or no harvest tool) unless they hold the block's tool at its level (either hand); stone and cobblestone need a pickaxe. Those with requiresTools false (silverfish, bears, yeti, minotaur, minoshroom, snow guardian, troll, wight) dig any solid, breakable block, stone included, just slower. So a cobblestone shelter stops zombies without a pickaxe, not bears, silverfish or trolls; a dirt or wooden one stops neither.

esmTweaks.from: NOT in the pinned zip: Mod Director (mods/!mod-director-launchwrapper-1.9.1.jar, config/mod-director/requisites.remote.json) downloads it at server start from https://github.com/lirkas/ESM-Tweaks/releases/download/v0.4.5-compat/esmtweaks-1.12.2-0.4.5.jar, named by the list at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Rebirth-of-the-Night/Rebirth-Of-The-Night/stable/config/mod-director/fd-3.3.4/file-director_requisites.bundle.json (a moving branch; fetched 2026-11-07, SHA-256 48ba1339ebf6417ad571d29589e61dd0d5745dc34549b2065676ccf5a4de3792; no hash is pinned). The dump manifest and the server ping list esmtweaks 0.4.5

universalTweaks.from: the pinned pack zip; only its Breakable Bedrock tweak matters here

configs: config/tool_progression/blocks.cfg (a record Tool Progression writes on every launch; it matches the rule but is not read as input)

when: Only while the mob has a live attack target within its follow range (squared distance 1 to followRange^2), its navigator has no path to it, and it has stood on the same block since the last check. It raytraces from points in its body toward the target, 'reach' (2) blocks long, and digs the first block hit if canHarvest allows it; if the target is within 2 blocks horizontally and more than 'verticalTrigger' (2) blocks above or below, it digs straight up or down instead. It keeps digging the same block while it is within 'keepWithin' (4) blocks. After a block breaks it paths to the target again.
digTime: Per tick the block gets digSpeed / hardness / 30 when its material needs no tool or the held item can harvest it, else / 100 (the player formula); it breaks when that times (ticks + 1) reaches 1. With an empty hand on the ground and no potion effects, digSpeed is 1: about 30 x hardness ticks for dirt (0.5: 15 ticks), sand, wood (planks, logs 2.0: 60 ticks), about 100 x hardness ticks for stone (1.5: 150 ticks) and cobblestone (2.0: 200 ticks) when requiresTools is false. Off the ground or in water the speed is divided by 5; Mining Fatigue slows it further. Bedrock is breakable in this pack (hardness 200, rock): about 20000 ticks for any digger. A solid block with hardness 0 never finishes (see evidence).

toolProgressionExceptions.note: Block states where config/tool_progression/block_overwrites.cfg changes the by-hand answer of the material rule (ESM-Tweaks HarvestUtil.canBreakBlockByHand reads Tool Progression's overwrites first). byHand: an optional-tool ('?') overwrite on a block whose material needs a tool; needsTool: a tool-required overwrite on a block whose material needs none. The oreDict section changes no answer; keys without a meta are invalid (Tool Progression logs and skips them).

evidence: ESM-Tweaks CommonProxy.serverAboutToStart: unregisters ESM's AdditionDigger and registers DiggingAITaskAddition when config/esmtweaks.cfg useTweakedAI=true (line 'B:useTweakedAI=true'); DiggingAITaskAddition.isValid = CfgProps.DIGGING for the entity ('Digging'), getTaskPriority 4, getAdditionalAI = AltEntityAIDigging

Which mobs: config/esm/entity_ai.json 'entities' with "Digging": true (56). ESM reads a mob's own entry only: EsmJsonConfig.readJson stores each entry as written (lambda$readJson$1, deepJsonCopy) and the 'default' block under the key null; get(ResourceLocation) returns the mob's entry, or the default block only when the mob has none; CfgProperty.get reads the key from that one object, and CfgPropBoolean reads it with JsonHelper.getBoolean(json, key, false) (lambda$new$0: iconst_0), which returns false when the key is missing. Nothing fills missing keys (ConfigHandler.initConfigs reads entity_ai.json, then writes it back). So the 16 diggers without 'Requires Tools' have it false, not the default block's true, and no digger has a 'Digging Blacklist' (an empty list), so the default block's blacklist protects nothing

Which blocks: AltEntityAIDigging.canHarvest: no if hardness < 0 (HarvestUtil.isBlockUnbreakable), no if in the mob's Digging Blacklist (unless inverted), no if the material is not solid (Material.isSolid), yes if 'Requires Tools' is false; otherwise, with mustHaveCorrectTool=true, canHarvestBlock: HarvestUtil.canBreakWithItem(main hand), then the off hand (checkBothHands=true). canBreakWithItem: yes if canBreakBlockByHand, else yes if one of the item's tool classes equals the block's harvest tool and its level is at least the block's harvest level

canBreakBlockByHand: no if hardness < 0; with Tool Progression loaded, yes if the block state has an overwrite with toolRequired false ('?'), or no overwrite and Material.isToolNotRequired; then yes if the block's harvest tool is null or the string 'null'; else no. Tool Progression BlockHelper.createFromConfigString: toolRequired = no '?' (the 'effective' group of its REGEX); BlockOverwriteConfig.parseBlockCategory expands meta '*' to 0-15 and needs a meta (the key regex); load() parses oreDict then block

The dump (blocks.json): material, toolRequired (= !Material.isToolNotRequired), harvestTool and harvestLevel after Tool Progression applied its overwrites (minecraft:stonebrick pickaxe level 1, hardness 27.5; minecraft:snow harvest tool 'null'). solid is Material.blocksMovement, which equals isSolid for every material in the dump except web (isSolid true)

Speed: AltEntityAIDigging.updateTask (func_75246_d): progress = HarvestUtil.getBlockStrength x (digTick + 1); at 1 or more World.destroyBlock(pos, false) and, if canHarvest, Block.harvestBlock with a fake player holding the mob's items (so it drops). getBlockStrength: hardness / digSpeed, / 30 if the material needs no tool or the item can harvest the block, else / 100; getDiggingSpeed: 1 empty-handed or the item's destroy speed, Efficiency, Haste, Mining Fatigue, / 5 in water or off the ground

When: AltEntityAIDigging.shouldExecute (func_75250_a): attack target alive, PathNavigate.noPath, squared distance at least 1 and at most getPathSearchRange^2, same BlockPos as last check, every searchBlockInterval ticks; keeps curBlock while getDistanceSq <= 16 and canHarvest; else getNextBlock(target, 2.0): rayTraceBlocks from the body toward the target, scaled by 2.0, or straight up or down by 2.0 when the target is within 2 blocks (distanceSq < 4) and more than 2 above or below

config/tool_progression/blocks.cfg agrees for the shelter blocks (a generated record, not an input): minecraft:dirt:0, grass:0, gravel:0, sand:0 '?shovel=0'; log:0, planks:0 '?axe=0'; stone:0, cobblestone:0, mossy_cobblestone:0 'pickaxe=0'; stonebrick:0 'pickaxe=1'; block_overwrites.cfg overwrites none of them (lead's #335 review input, 2026-11-07)

Hardness 0: HarvestUtil.getBlockStrength returns 0 when the hardness is 0 or less (fcmpg, ifgt, fconst_0, freturn), and AltEntityAIDigging.updateTask sets progress = getBlockStrength x (digTick + 1), so it never reaches 1; canHarvest still says yes (isBlockUnbreakable only tests hardness < 0). canMobDig answers no for such states

Rate for a mob with an empty hand: getBlockStrength divides by 30 only when Material.isToolNotRequired (func_76229_l) or the held stack is not empty and canHarvestBlock; otherwise by 100. So ticksByHand is 100 x hardness for a block whose material needs a tool, also for a mob without Requires Tools and for a block with no harvest tool

Bedrock is breakable (Universal Tweaks 1.9.0, mods/UniversalTweaks-1.12.2-1.9.0.jar): UTBreakableBedrockMixin @Redirects the 7th registerBlock(int, String, Block) call (ordinal 6) in Block.registerBlocks (refmap: func_149671_p, func_176219_a) to register new Block(Material.ROCK) with setHardness(200.0) and setResistance(6000000.0) instead. UTLoadingPlugin.shouldMixinConfigQueue applies mixins.tweaks.blocks.breakablebedrock.json on the server only when UTConfigTweaks.BLOCKS.BREAKABLE_BEDROCK.utBreakableBedrockToggle is true (code default false); config/Universal Tweaks - Tweaks.cfg sets B:"[1] Breakable Bedrock Toggle"=true. The dump agrees: minecraft:bedrock is the only block with hardness 200, material rock, harvest tool null, explosionResistance 3600000 (= 6000000 x 3 / 5)

Bedrock tool list: S:"[2] Tool List" < twilightforest:fiery_pickaxe > with S:"[3] List Mode"=WHITELIST (the code default is BLACKLIST), so for players only the fiery pickaxe mines it. UTBreakableBedrock.utMineBedrock enforces that list only as a @SubscribeEvent handler for PlayerInteractEvent$LeftClickBlock (it cancels the click on Blocks.BEDROCK when the main-hand item fails the list). A digging mob raises no such event (updateTask calls World.destroyBlock), and HarvestUtil.isBlockUnbreakable tests hardness < 0 only, so every digger can dig bedrock by hand (harvest tool null): about 200 x 100 = 20000 ticks (fixture universaltweaks-bedrock.javap.txt; lead #339 review, 2026-11-07)
unverified: No run has watched a mob dig; the times are from the formula

Which mobs spawn holding a pickaxe or shovel, and its level (vanilla zombies can get an iron shovel; RotN's equipment mods were not read); shouldGetExtraTool=false only stops ESM-Tweaks from adding one
Mod materials other than web whose isSolid differs from blocksMovement (the dump records blocksMovement)
Griefing (ESM's AdditionGrief: chests, furnaces, crafting tables, doors, glass and crops from its Grief Targets list) and pillaring are separate AIs, not covered here
ESM-Tweaks comes from a moving remote list, not the pinned zip; a change there changes this behaviour

The dump records hardness 0 for 564 solid states (for example minecraft:tnt, slime, sponge and stone_slab2, many slabs, walls and stairs from contentcreator, earthworks and aesthetics). Vanilla sponge (0.6) and red sandstone slabs (2.0) are not 0, so some of those values may be what the dumper read at its probe position rather than the in-game hardness, as with Dynamic Trees trunk shells; canMobDig says no for them because of that 0
